articles.title: How to ask for help from Student Service
articles.summary: Use Student Service for general office support, guidance, and portal questions.
articles.content: Student Service is the main help desk for office support, rules guidance, and non-academic process questions. Use a ticket when you need a response or follow-up.

articles.title: When to use Chancellery vs Student Service
articles.summary: Student Service handles general help. Chancellery handles exam appeals and retake requests.
articles.content: Use Student Service for general office support, documents guidance, finance questions, and portal help. Use Chancellery only for grade appeals and retake request workflows after exams.

articles.title: Registration and enrollment help
articles.summary: What to prepare before asking about course registration and enrollment issues.
articles.content: When opening a registration ticket, include your student ID, semester, course name, and the exact problem you saw in the portal. This helps Student Service review your case faster.

articles.title: Technical portal support checklist
articles.summary: What to send when a portal page is broken or not loading correctly.
articles.content: Include the page name, your role, your faculty, what button you clicked, and a screenshot when the page freezes or shows the wrong version. This lets Student Service reproduce the issue quickly.

articles.title: Finance and payment support
articles.summary: How to request help about balances, payment confirmation, and finance follow-up.
articles.content: When you contact Student Service about finance, include your student ID, the amount or invoice you are referring to, and the date of the payment or charge. Student Service can guide the next step and document the issue, but cannot edit finance records from this workspace.

articles.title: Documents and certificate requests
articles.summary: What to include when you need a transcript, certificate, or official document.
articles.content: For document requests, include the document name, language needs, deadline, and where it will be used. Student Service can confirm what is needed and keep the request moving, while official document generation stays in the proper office workflow.

macros.label: Ask for more details
macros.message: Thank you for contacting Student Service. Please send your student ID, the exact page or process you were using, and a screenshot or short description of what happened so we can review this quickly.

macros.label: Registration guidance
macros.message: Thanks for the details. Please confirm your semester, course name, and group if applicable. Student Service can guide the process here, but enrollment records are updated in the academic workflow rather than directly from this workspace.

macros.label: Finance guidance
macros.message: Please share your student ID, the payment or balance amount, and the payment date if available. Student Service can document the issue and guide the next step, but finance records are not edited from this workspace.

macros.label: Document request follow-up
macros.message: Please confirm which document you need, the language, and the deadline. Student Service can help you prepare the request and keep you updated, while official document generation stays in the formal office workflow.

macros.label: Portal troubleshooting
macros.message: Please send the page name, your current role, your faculty, the exact button or action you clicked, and a screenshot if possible. This will help us reproduce the issue and respond faster.
